key.name: launchpad-toggle
key.summary: Open / close Launchpad

key.name: briefing-show
key.summary: Show the briefing card again

key.name: login-intro
key.summary: Login intro: greeting, the wallpaper fades up, the top bar, dock and desk widgets fly in (replay: os.bapirlo.Desk.Intro)

key.name: briefing-mode
key.summary: When the login briefing appears: first-login (of the day), every-login, off

key.name: briefing-last
key.summary: Date (YYYY-MM-DD) the briefing last appeared by itself

key.name: briefing-delay
key.summary: Seconds after login before the briefing slides in

key.name: widgets
key.summary: Desktop widgets (clock, calendar, deadlines, weather, system) on the wallpaper

key.name: widgets-corner
key.summary: Where the widget row sits on the primary screen
key.description: Cards that were never dragged line up from this corner; dragged cards keep their own spot.

key.name: widgets-dodge
key.summary: Cards step out of the way of the wallpaper's main subject
key.description: The Wallpapers app finds where the character / subject is (~/.local/state/bapirlo/wallpaper/subject.json); a card that would cover it moves to the nearest free spot beside it. Edit mode shows the cards at their own spots.

key.name: widgets-cards
key.summary: Which desktop widget cards show: clock, calendar, upnext, weather, system, nowplaying, todo, notes

key.name: widgets-edit
key.summary: Edit the desktop widgets (drag them, show / hide cards)

key.name: pip-on-top
key.summary: Keep picture-in-picture and Live Captions windows above everything

key.name: popout-toggle
key.summary: Pop the focused window out into a live picture-in-picture (press again to close it)

key.name: todo-add
key.summary: Add a to-do (opens the desk widgets in edit mode, cursor in the To-do card)

key.name: radial-toggle
key.summary: Open / close the radial launcher around the pointer

key.name: radial-apps
key.summary: Apps in the radial launcher (desktop ids, up to 8; empty = the first 8 dock favourites)

key.name: session-restore
key.summary: After login, reopen last session's apps: auto, ask (notification), off

key.name: session-skip
key.summary: Apps (desktop ids) never saved or reopened by session restore

key.name: privacy-dots
key.summary: Coloured dots in the top bar while mic / camera / screen sharing are in use

key.name: airpods
key.summary: AirPods battery chip in the top bar (data from LibrePods)
